name: Does Aurora’s dry climate affect how custom wood trim is installed?

mainEntity.name: Does Aurora’s dry climate affect how custom wood trim is installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The semi-arid climate and sharp seasonal humidity swings in Aurora cause interior framing and wood trim to expand and contract considerably. If natural wood moldings are installed immediately after delivery, they can shrink or buckle as they dry out indoors, causing seams and caulked joints to pull apart. To prevent this, trim boards should sit inside your climate-controlled home for several days prior to installation so their moisture content stabilizes to indoor conditions before cutting and fastening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes; wood trim must acclimate inside your climate-controlled home for a few days to adjust to Aurora’s dry air and prevent joint shrinkage or warping.
